subject.title: feat(feeds): search and follow signed publisher feeds

question: Should signed publisher-feed discovery, follow state, and its CLI live in OpenClaw core rather than a ClawHub or plugin-owned surface?
rationale: This PR adds a broad new signed-feed and durable-state capability, while current-main boundary evidence could not be independently inspected and the item has a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Sponsor the core workflow
options.body: Confirm that the core CLI, verified transport, and SQLite state are intended product surfaces, then require full security and deployed-transport review.

options.title: Externalize the workflow
options.body: Keep core to generic extension seams and move publisher discovery/follow behavior to an owning ClawHub package or plugin.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core workflow
recommendation.body: Confirm that the core CLI, verified transport, and SQLite state are intended product surfaces, then require full security and deployed-transport review.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main feature owner could be established because the required repository history reads could not execute.
